name: Smeltmaster Koll
title: Master of the Pour
examine: Burn-freckled forearms and a squint calibrated in furnace-light. He judges everything by how it would pour.
lines: Three furnaces, one rule: the charge goes in clean or the day goes wrong. Everything else about smelting is opinion.
Balla gets first pick of my coal and pretends she doesn't. I get first pick of her scrap and pretend the same. The mountain runs on pretending.
Every tenth bar walks next door to Runa's counter for the Crown. I pour eleven so I never have to count in front of her.
